newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Reed Elsevier seeks better spread across Europe.
newsitem.headline: Reed Elsevier seeks better spread across Europe.

text.p: Anglo-Dutch publishing group Reed Elsevier said on Wednesday it wanted to achieve a greater geographic spread of its sales within Europe.

Co-chairman Herman Bruggink told a results presentation that the group was broadly satisfied with its spread across the major regions of the world, with North America contributing 46 percent of sales in 1996, Europe 42 percent and Asia/Pacific 12 percent.
But within Europe the group would like to achieve a better spread, he said, noting that Britain accounted for 23 percent of sales, the Netherlands six and other countries just 13 percent.
"The spread over Europe is not ideal and we're working to change that," he said.
